title: Symplectic Runge-Kutta Discretization for Non-Linear Hamiltonian Systems
summary: Numerical integration of Hamiltonian and non-linear dynamical systems frequently suffers from long-term secular energy drift under explicit Runge-Kutta schemes. We investigate symplectic 4th-order Runge-Kutta formulations that preserve phase-space volume and energy conservation invariants. Evaluated on double pendulum and Lotka-Volterra dynamics, our scheme bounds energy dissipation to 1e-6 over 100,000 steps with O(h^4) empirical convergence.
